Why can't you focus on a book anymore? Why do you go blank in conversations? Why does your brain feel slower than it used to? You're not getting dumber. You've just been training your brain to do the wrong thing for years — without realizing it. Here's the neuroscience behind brain rot, what scrolling actually does to your deep thinking ability, and how to reverse it.
